seo_description: Miles Caton as Samuel “Sammie” Moore in Ryan Coogler's Sinners: the role, the guitar and the soundtrack.
label: The role
logline: A preacher's son with a blues guitar, caught between his father's church and his cousins' new juke joint, where his playing calls up something nobody invited. It was his first feature, and he plays it opposite Michael B. Jordan.

dusk.line: One night. One juke joint. And a kid whose guitar could *bend time.*
dusk.song_note: One of five soundtrack songs he sings on.

feature: He learned guitar for the role. On screen he plays a *resonator,* and he recorded a substantial share of the acoustic guitar on the soundtrack.
